component.name: HelixNotes
component.summary: Local Markdown notes with wiki-links, tasks and a graph view

description.p: This is a community package of HelixNotes, maintained independently. It repackages the official upstream Linux build unmodified.
HelixNotes is a local Markdown note-taking app. Your notes are ordinary .md files in a folder you choose — no account, no company cloud, no lock-in.

ul.li: Markdown editor with a toolbar, slash commands, source mode and code highlighting
Wiki-links between notes, an outline panel and a graph view
Tasks view that collects checklists from every note, with priorities, due dates and a calendar
Full-text search that also handles Chinese, Japanese and Korean
Daily notes, tags with autocomplete, KaTeX math and Mermaid diagrams
Version history with diffs, automatic backups and encrypted secret blocks
Optional WebDAV sync to your own server, and AI writing tools via Ollama or an OpenAI-compatible endpoint

description.p: A vault is just a folder of Markdown files. By default this package can reach only your Documents folder; the app's own settings, search index, backups and version history live inside the sandbox and need no extra permission. To keep a vault somewhere else, grant that location:

ul.li: Anywhere in your home: flatpak override --user --filesystem=home com.helixnotes.app
Just one folder: flatpak override --user --filesystem=~/Sync/Notes com.helixnotes.app
An external drive: flatpak override --user --filesystem=/run/media/YOURNAME/DRIVE com.helixnotes.app

description.p: The app also offers to open a note's folder in your file manager; that goes through the desktop portal and needs no permission of its own.
